::: {.repo}
### vSmartMOM / vSmartMOM.jl

I developed vSmartMOM, originally written in Fortran and C++, as a vector (polarized) matrix-operator radiative transfer model with analytic derivatives
([Sanghavi et al. 2013](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jqsrt.2012.10.021);
[Sanghavi, Davis & Eldering 2014](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jqsrt.2013.09.004)). Since 2020 it
has been rebuilt as the open-source Julia package **vSmartMOM.jl**. The Julia port began with
Christian Frankenberg and Schmidt Software Fellow Rupesh Jeyaram, whose work I supervised (2020–2022;
[JOSS 2022](https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.04575)).
I lead its scientific development (formulations, linearization, Raman scattering, retrieval
methodology); Christian Frankenberg contributes software engineering, performance and release
integration.

Today vSmartMOM.jl runs the same physics on heterogeneous CPU/GPU hardware and includes:

- polarized multiple scattering with **analytic Jacobians**, including surface SIF;
- **rotational and vibrational Raman scattering**;
- line-by-line absorption from **HITRAN, HITEMP and ExoMol**;
- a **fully coupled canopy–atmosphere** treatment. Rather than a simple BRDF, the canopy
  (with atmosphere inside it) is a scattering medium described by leaf optical properties and
  leaf angular distributions, with the soil as the lower boundary. It was benchmarked in the
  JRC's first coupled surface–atmosphere intercomparison,
  [RAMI4ATM](https://rami-benchmark.jrc.ec.europa.eu/_www/RAMI4ATM.php);
- a polarized Cox–Munk ocean surface, with fully coupled **ocean–atmosphere** radiative
  transfer in development;
- brown-dwarf and directly imaged exoplanet radiative transfer (via ExoOptics.jl).

It is used for Earth-observation work (SIF and greenhouse-gas retrieval biases, Carbon-I) and
HWO reflected-light simulations.

[GitHub](https://github.com/RemoteSensingTools/vSmartMOM.jl) ·
[Documentation](https://RemoteSensingTools.github.io/vSmartMOM.jl/dev/) ·
[JOSS paper](https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.04575) ·
[Method paper (JQSRT 2014)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jqsrt.2013.09.004)

```julia
using Pkg; Pkg.add("vSmartMOM")
```
:::

## Milestones

<!-- From the GitHub history of RemoteSensingTools/vSmartMOM.jl and companion repos (checked Oct 2026). -->

```{=html}
<ul class="news">
  <li><span class="date">2013–2014</span>
    <strong>vSmartMOM</strong> (Fortran / C++) by Suniti Sanghavi: vector matrix-operator radiative transfer,
    linearized with respect to aerosol and surface properties.</li>
  <li><span class="date">2020</span>
    Julia rewrite begins (initially <code>RadiativeTransfer.jl</code>), with GPU/CPU kernels from the start and
    HITRAN-based cross-sections.</li>
  <li><span class="date">2021</span>
    Benchmarked against 6SV1; first inelastic (Raman) core routines added (Dec 2021).</li>
  <li><span class="date">2022</span>
    Raman optical properties and RT formalism (JQSRT Part I; Part II 2023); ExoMol/HITEMP support;
    canopy optics (<code>CanopyOptics.jl</code>); v1.0 release and <em>JOSS</em> paper.</li>
  <li><span class="date">2024–2025</span>
    Raman correction for OCO-2/3 SIF retrievals (GRL 2025); v1.1.</li>
  <li><span class="date">2026</span>
    v2 series (v2.1, v2.2): fully coupled canopy–atmosphere RT (RAMI4ATM), polarized ocean surface and
    <code>OceanOptics.jl</code>, GPU line-by-line absorption in <code>AtmosphericAbsorption.jl</code>
    (HITRAN &amp; ExoMol, Voigt to Hartmann–Tran, line mixing, MT_CKD/CIA), <code>ExoOptics.jl</code> for brown dwarfs
    and exoplanets, analytic Jacobians for multi-sensor retrievals (12–20× faster in tested inversions), and
    the Google radiative transfer benchmark dataset.</li>
  <li><span class="date">In development</span>
    Fully coupled ocean–atmosphere radiative transfer.</li>
</ul>
```

## The RemoteSensingTools ecosystem

::: {.repo}
| Package | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [vSmartMOM.jl](https://github.com/RemoteSensingTools/vSmartMOM.jl) | Polarized matrix-operator RT with Raman, canopy, ocean and analytic Jacobians |
| [ExoOptics.jl](https://github.com/RemoteSensingTools/ExoOptics.jl) | Brown-dwarf and directly imaged exoplanet RT, built on vSmartMOM.jl |
| [AtmosphericAbsorption.jl](https://github.com/RemoteSensingTools/AtmosphericAbsorption.jl) | GPU-accelerated molecular cross-sections from HITRAN & ExoMol |
| [CanopyOptics.jl](https://github.com/RemoteSensingTools/CanopyOptics.jl) | Canopy optical properties (leaf optics, leaf angle distributions) |
| [OceanOptics.jl](https://github.com/RemoteSensingTools/OceanOptics.jl) | Ocean optical properties for radiative transfer |
| [InstrumentOperator.jl](https://github.com/RemoteSensingTools/InstrumentOperator.jl) | Instrument line shapes for hyperspectral sensors |
:::
